title: Elevate UI Readability: Optimize CSS 'line-height' for Seamless Web Font Experience
tweet: Boost your UI's #UserExperience! Learn how to fine-tune CSS 'line-height' for impeccable #WebFonts & #CSSTypography. Make your text a joy to read. Dive into our latest guide! #UIDesign #TypographyTips
tip: For superior #CSSTypography & #UIDesign, always use unitless values for 'line-height' (e.g., 1.6) so it scales proportionally with 'font-size'. This ensures consistent readability across various screen sizes and #WebFonts, significantly improving #UserExperience.
